Description
The 20 Gram PAMP Suisse Gold Bar is a beautiful investment-grade gold bullion bar produced by the world’s leading swiss precious metal refiner,
PAMP
, and is a part of the most popular series of the PAMP i.e the Lady Fortuna Series.
These 20 gram gold bars are produced by PAMP in Switzerland, which has some of the highest transparency and authenticity standards in the whole gold business (as well as one of the most remarkable facilities in the world). They’ve retained that title for more than 35 years, having begun manufacturing some of the best bars and ingots in the world as early as 1977. This bar also has world-class Veriscan technology, which is one of its many outstanding characteristics.
The 20 Gram PAMP Suisse gold bar contain 20g of .9999 fine gold and each of these gold comes with its original assay card and their value gains even more security with new Veriscan® technology that helps to ensure the gold bars authenticity and purity when buying from the secondary market.
PAMP Suisse’s unique
Veriscan® technology
uses the metal’s microscopic topography, similar to a fingerprint, to identify registered products and thus help identify counterfeits. Each ingot is scanned during production and then authenticated via the Veriscan® database when the customer scans.
These gold bars are certainly not inexpensive but that doesn’t mean it is shoddy and that you should be scared off by it. In fact, the bar is highly polished and beautiful as well as being laden with all the hallmarks traits of a good quality gold bar without having to pay exorbitant prices to it. This is one of the most loved and highly after gold bars in the world.
Design of 20 Gram Gold Bar – PAMP Suisse Lady Fortuna
The design is one of the most beautiful ever to appear on an ingot, and the entire world is enamored with it.
Lady Fortuna, the Roman goddess of chance, fortune, and luck, is depicted on the front of the gold bar. This bar is distinctive and special for a number of reasons, one of which is the presence of the lady. The lady Fortuna is depicted blindfolded and
sharing her rich cornucopia with others – the symbol of the unpredictability of life and luck.
The reverse of these 20 Gram Gold bars features the company’s unique PAMP emblem which consists of the words “PAMP” enclosed inside a four small circle followed by the term “Sussie” just beneath it. The other inscription that is depicted on the reverse of these gold bars is weight, purity, assayers mark along with the unique serial number.
Main Highlights of 20 Gram PAMP Suisse Gold Bar –  Lady Fortuna
Contains 20 gram(0.643 oz) of .9999 pure gold.
Produced by the world’s leading swiss precious metal refiner, PAMP Sussie
Individual gold bars come in a protective plastic slip along with its original assay card.
Features the Veriscan Technology which provides extra security and authenticity to the gold bars.
Eligible for Precious Metal IRAs.
On the obverse, Lady Fortuna, the Roman goddess of luck and fortune, is depicted blindfolded along with cornucopia.
On the reverse, The company’s unique PAMP Suisse logo, as well as the weight, purity, and serial number is depicted.
Each gold bar contains a unique serial number.
